## Checklist
- [ ] I can explain every line of this diff without help
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `ci:`, `infra:`, `docs:`, `chore:` ...)
- [ ] No secrets, account-specific values or debug leftovers added
- [ ] Docs / ADR / runbook updated if behaviour or a design decision changed
